notes: New videos get a cover picture: the picture File Explorer shows for them. By default it is the first moment someone is seen in the video; if nobody is found, the middle of the video. Each page's Output card has a 'Cover picture' list: first picture with a person (default), the middle of the video, or let Windows choose (as before). Up to 120 pictures through the video are looked at, so it adds a few seconds per video. The picture is copied into the file; the video and its sound are not changed.
Only MP4 and MOV videos get one: Windows ignores a picture inside an MKV.
Videos of the matching moments (Footage search) get one too.
